Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF THE WORKS AND SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT Sub: : Annual Maintenance Service Contract for Electrical Articulating boo m lifts of Haulotte make available at Various substations of SR-II for 3 Year s-Reg 1.0 Scope of Work: Annual Maintenance service Contract for Electrical Articulating boom lifts of Ha ulotte make, available at various substations of SR-II for period Three(3) Years at various substations in SR-II.The scope of work under the subject package co vers the inspection of the machine as per the below check points o Raise the platform to the maximum height.

o Visually inspect the inner and outer channels of the columns for debris or foreign material. Will use a mild cleaning solvent to clean the columns a nd the entire machine. o Inspect all decals for legibility and damage. Replace any damaged or ille gible decal immediately. o Inspect the entire machine for damage and improperly installed or missin g parts including: a. Electrical components, wiring and electrical cables b. Electrical cable anchors and pulleys c. Hydraulic power unit, hoses, fittings, cylinder(s) and manifolds d. Power cables, anchors and pulleys e. Lifting chains and anchor pins f. Nuts, bolts and other fasteners g. Hydraulic manifolds and pump h. Dents or damage to machine i. Corrosion or oxidation j. Cracks in welds or structural components o Inspect the entire machine for damage and improperly installed or missin g parts including: a. Hydraulic power unit—tank, valves, fittings b. Hydraulic cylinder(s) c. Flow control valve d. Ground area under the machine e. Hydraulic hoses and fittings o Check the Auxiliary Lowering and the Manual Lowering of platform. o Confirming the following: a. Cables are on the pulleys b. Upper and lower cable ends are properly secured c. Upper and lower mounting brackets are properly secured o Test the Power and Function Controls as per the procedure o Inspect the Breather Cap o Inspect the Electrical Wiring at the following areas for burnt, chafed, at th e following locations and repair if required: a. All base wiring b. Inside ground control box

c. Hydraulic power unit d. All external electrical cables e. Inside platform control box o Inspect All Welds at the following locations and repair if required: a. Platform b. Base o Clean and Lubricate the Columns o Test the Level Sensing Operation o Inspect the Boom/Scissor Assembly for Wear as per the procedure: a. Detection of excessive or unusual wear in the boom/scissor assembl y (It is essential for safe machine operation An unsafe working conditi on exists if the mast assembly has excessive wear or does not operat e smoothly, free of hesitation and binding) b. Visually inspect the top of each column for clearance between the w ear pads and the adjacent column surface 2.0 Details of Electrical Articulating boom lifts: S.No Station Model Qty 1 Udumalpet SS HA260PX 1 No. 2 Thiruvalam HA260PX 1 No. 3 Nagapattinam HA260PX 1 No. 4 Kudgi HA260PX 1 No. 5 Tumkur HA260PX 1 No. 6 Tuticorin PS HA260PX 1 No. 7 Dharmapuri HA260PX 1 No. 8 Pavagada HA16RTJ 1 No. 9 HVDC Pugalur HA32RTJPRO 2 Nos.

3.0 General Terms and conditions: · The Boom lift including all accessories should be serviced four times during the cont ract period as per standard checklists. · The per year cost of AMC include 04 preventive maintenance Visits of service engine er. Additional Visits will be on chargeable basis. · Breakdown calls should be attended during the contract period on call basis and sa me will be paid extra as per the bill of quantities. · The service Engineer should inform well in advance to concerned site for avoiding h amper to planned shutdown / Maintenance activities. · Service Engineer should do the work utmost satisfaction of concerned Engineer In-c harge. If the EIC feels the work is not done properly, contractor has to re-work withou t additional implication to POWERGRID. · After completion of each visit, service Engineer should submit service report, spares list required for the machine. · Bills should be raised per quarter after completion of visits along with duly signed se rvice report. · The normal working hours is 8 Hours per day . · Ordinary tools & tackles and consumables, any special tool or diagnostic equipment required for the visit is in the scope of contractor. · Any machining or welding services will be arranged as per the site requirement but however the necessary supervision of work is under contractor scope. · POWERGRID shall provide unskilled manpower assistance for taking up the se rvices at each station. · Exclusion : a. Spare parts and consumables are excluded from AMC. b. Hydraulic oil c. Engine Related service d. Structural repair and overhauling. · Gemini power hydraulics need to maintain the sufficient spares in INDIA in ord er to attend breakdowns and to reduce the down time § The rates offered inspection, maintenance and repair works shall include the tra vel expenses, lodging & boarding of service charges of Engineer. § MOM/Service report shall be made on every completion of work & visit by contr actor. § Additional spares If any required other than listed spares for taking the plant in t o service, the same shall be supplied by the contractor on reasonable rate. § One Service card shall be opened for each machine and enter the history for fut ure reference.
